messages:
Marta L: Heads-up: Orchid Corp is getting latency spikes. They asked for a temporary route to a dedicated pool while we investigate. Suggest we use a short-lived header-based override instead of an org-wide pin. Thoughts? :eyes:

Ryan K: short-lived header seems safer. TTL + audit. Can we do a 1-hour window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ben P: If we use a header, need to ensure proxies preserve `X-Redwood-Routing-Tag` across LB and retries. Also record who applied it.

Marta L: Agree. Proposal: use `X-Redwood-Routing-Tag: orchid-temp-<random>` with expires=3600s. Create an audit event `routing.override_applied` that includes issuer and reason.

Zoe S: Also add a fallback: if orchid-dedicated pool is full, route to the most cost-efficient compatible variant rather than the global default, otherwise we might OOM the pool.

Ben P: Example policy snippet I sketched:
```yaml
match:
  header: "X-Redwood-Routing-Tag"
action:
  route: pool:orchid-dedicated
  ttl: 3600
  audit: true
```

Ryan K: Who approves these? We need an approvals/CS flow. Also would be nice to expose a Console UI for temporary tags: Operate > Route Overrides > Create temporary tag.

Marta L: For short-term, infra team can create via admin API. I'll add an endpoint `POST /internal/admin/routing-tags` with body { org_id, tag, ttl_seconds, reason, issuer }.

infra-bot: deploy-bot created ticket INF-314 to add endpoint. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/2223

Zoe S: Remember to rate-limit and require service-account auth on the admin API. And emit TTL expiry events so we can auto-clean and alert if it wasn't revoked properly.

Ben P: One more: ensure metrics/evals and billing metadata are preserved. Temporary tag requests should carry `x-routing-metadata: temporary` so downstream systems filter them out of long-term evals.

Marta L: I'll draft a short runbook for CS to request temporary tag, include rollback steps if it causes regressions. Assigning to myself. :white_check_mark:
